workflow.renamePlan.apply.partial: Applied {{applied}}, {{failed}} failed — see the rows marked Failed for reasons.
workflow.renamePlan.undo.confirmContent: Every applied rename is reverted to its original name where the disk still allows it.
workflow.renamePlan.undo.partial: Undid {{undone}}, {{blocked}} blocked — see the rows still marked Applied for reasons.

Wrapped content matching this set's entries is removed together with its wrappers.
workflow.activity.textRemoveWrapped.summ: Pick a wrappers type and a text set to enable this step.
workflow.activity.textRemoveTexts.set.de: Bare occurrences of this set's entries are removed from the text.
workflow.activity.textRemoveTexts.summar: Pick a text set to enable this step.
workflow.activity.textTrim.trimEnds.labe: Trim whitespace and separators from both ends
workflow.activity.textTrim.summary.noop: All switches off — this step changes nothing.

workflow.activity.textCapture.groups.non: no named groups yet — add (?<name>…) to capture something

Rebuilds the working text. {var:name} inserts a variable, {var:name:pad(2)} zero-pads it, {originalText} is the incoming text.

workflow.trigger.fsScheduledScan.interva: 0 turns the schedule off — the definition stays runnable by hand.

workflow.enhancer.enhance.label: Enhancers
workflow.enhancer.enhance.description: Leave empty to run whatever the resource's profile says, which is where that decision already lives.
workflow.pathmark.enqueueSync.descriptio: Re-reads the folders your marks cover, so files a chain just placed become resources without waiting for the next scan.
workflow.activity.downloaderEnqueue.desc: The link decides which downloader is used. A link no downloader here can fetch is left alone rather than queued.
workflow.activity.downloaderEnqueue.inte: Minimum 1000ms — the slowest platform's floor, not a preference.
workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.handler: Downloads through the configured aria2 RPC endpoint, then continues when the files are complete.
Opens the magnet with the server’s default application. This step does not track the external client; follow it with a node that waits for files in the pending processing folder.
Only if aria2 was started with --rpc-secret.
workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.timeout: Stops this download if it has not completed within this time.
workflow.field.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose, inputs and expected result.
workflow.field.nodeNotesDescription: Document this node’s role in this workflow. Notes do not affect execution or configuration checks.
workflow.description.empty: No workflow description yet. Open the editor to inspect each node’s description and configuration.
workflow.diagnostics.title: Configuration check
workflow.diagnostics.limit: Checks current node configuration and the server environment only. It does not verify links or guarantee successful execution.
workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.handler: Downloads on the server and stops seeding when complete. Speed and availability depend on peers and connectivity.
workflow.activity.acquisition.resolveSha: Reads accessible sharing pages or full shared text and uses the configured AI to extract links and passwords. Login-protected or dynamic pages may be unavailable. This node does not download files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.selectLink: Selects a parsed download link using the configured preference order. It does not search drives by resource name or download files.
Downloads HTTP(S) files on the server with configurable connections, retries, speed limits and a timeout. Resumes only when saved progress and the server’s file version can be verified; otherwise restarts. The URL must return the file directly.
workflow.activity.acquisition.waitForInb: Waits for downloaded files to arrive in the server’s pending processing folder, then passes them to the next node. This node does not download files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchMagne: Processes a magnet using the selected download implementation. The built-in engine and aria2 can wait for completion; the system-default client requires a later node to receive its files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchTorre: Reads an uploaded .torrent file or the supplied HTTP(S) torrent URL and downloads on the server with the built-in BitTorrent engine. Preserves the content’s folder structure and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchFromP: Obtains or installs the resource through its linked platform account, then passes the platform’s directory to the next node. Requires the relevant account, permissions and server environment.
workflow.activity.acquisition.unpack.des: Inspects obtained files and extracts archives as configured, trying known passwords. It does not obtain missing files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.pickLocalD: Selects an existing folder accessible to the server for subsequent processing. A path on the browser’s computer may not be accessible to the server.
workflow.activity.acquisition.place.desc: Organizes files using the library folder and path template, then passes the resulting directory to the next node.
workflow.activity.acquisition.materializ: Associates the resulting directory with the resource, giving its placeholder record local files. This node does not download or move files.
workflow.validation.acquisition.invalidC: The node configuration is invalid. Check its fields.
workflow.validation.acquisition.inboxMis: No pending processing folder is configured. Select a server folder in download settings.
workflow.validation.acquisition.libraryM: No library folder is configured. Select a server folder in download settings.
workflow.validation.acquisition.director: The configured directory cannot be used. Check its server path and access permissions.
workflow.validation.acquisition.aiMissin: No AI model is configured for parsing shared content.
workflow.validation.acquisition.aiDisabl: The AI feature required to parse shared content is disabled.
workflow.validation.acquisition.platform: No acquisition implementation supports this platform.
The platform account or server environment is unavailable. Check the platform configuration.
workflow.validation.acquisition.invalidS: The acquisition source does not meet this node’s requirements. Check the input type and value.
workflow.validation.acquisition.timeoutI: The download timeout must be between 1 and 43200 minutes.
workflow.validation.acquisition.aria2Rpc: aria2 needs an HTTP(S) RPC URL and a poll interval between 1 and 60 seconds.
workflow.validation.acquisition.magnetIn: Enter a magnet link with a valid BitTorrent info hash.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpSour: Enter an HTTP(S) URL for the file itself.
workflow.validation.acquisition.torrentS: Upload a .torrent file or enter its HTTP(S) URL; local filesystem paths are not accepted.
workflow.validation.acquisition.systemHa: The system client opens on the server. Add a node that waits for files in the pending processing folder to receive the download.
workflow.validation.unknownTrigger: This trigger is unavailable. Choose an installed, supported trigger.
workflow.validation.invalidTriggerConfig: The trigger configuration is invalid. Check its filters and required fields.
workflow.validation.unknownActivity: This node is not installed or is unavailable. Replace it or restore its implementation.
workflow.validation.invalidContract: The node has an invalid input or output declaration. Check its implementation.
workflow.validation.typeMismatch: This node cannot accept the preceding output type. Adjust the node order or conversion.
workflow.validation.destructiveAfterAdap: Automatically adapted data cannot directly drive destructive operations such as deleting or moving files. Check the input and adjust the conversion.
workflow.validation.missingOutputType: This node needs an explicit output type. Set its target type in the configuration.
workflow.validation.invalidJson: The node configuration is not valid JSON. Correct its contents.
workflow.validation.validationFailed: The check could not finish. Review the node configuration and retry.
workflow.editor.builtinCopyHint: Save edits as a new workflow while keeping the built-in workflow and its existing tasks unchanged.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.parallelC: Maximum simultaneous connections; 1 uses a single connection.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.maxRetrie: Retry transient network failures; 0 disables retries.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.speedLimi: Total speed limit for this download; 0 means unlimited.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.timeoutMi: Maximum time for this download, including retries.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.automatic: Chunking is automatic when the server supports Range requests and its file version can be verified. Resume also needs a valid saved checkpoint. Otherwise, downloads use one connection or restart.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpConn: Parallel connections must be an integer between 1 and 16.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpRetr: The retry count must be an integer between 0 and 10.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpSpee: The speed limit must be an integer between 0 and 1048576 KiB/s; 0 means unlimited.
workflow.trigger.downloaderResultReady.d: Bind this workflow in the standalone downloader settings to run once when each gallery result is ready. A torrent is metadata that can be used to download the actual files. Tasks started from Get resources continue in their original workflow.
workflow.trigger.downloaderResultReady.k: Leave empty to handle every result. Select Torrent metadata to only continue BT downloads.
workflow.activity.downloaderFetchTorrent: Use the built-in BT service to download this gallery and record its completed directory. Multiple files and nested folders are preserved. Existing actual files pass through. This step does not create or materialize a resource.
workflow.activity.downloaderPrepareResou: Prepare download result for the library

Turn downloaded files into a resource acquisition context while retaining the gallery identity. Continue with unpacking, placement, and materialization steps. A result that only contains torrent metadata cannot be added to the library.
workflow.acquisition.fetchExHentai.descr: Send an ExHentai gallery link to its downloader. Obtain torrent metadata or images according to the site settings, then continue in this acquisition workflow. Configure an ExHentai account and download settings first.
Use the built-in BT service when the site returns a torrent, or continue immediately when actual files are available. Preserve multiple files and nested folders for the following library steps.
Download actual files with the built-in BT service after a standalone downloader obtains a gallery torrent, then record the directory. Only downloads by default; duplicate it to add organization and library steps.
workflow.validation.acquisition.exHentai: This node requires a valid ExHentai gallery link. Add the gallery page link to the pending resource.
workflow.trigger.postParserManual.descri: Read a post link, public page or pasted text and extract download information. No resource is required; a parsed link does not imply automatic download support.
Read the body and comments of a post or pasted text. Site readers use configured accounts. Generic reading may not support login, dynamic pages or restricted content. General workflows do not purchase content automatically.
workflow.activity.postParserExtractDownl: Use the post-parser AI configuration to extract a title, download links, access codes and archive passwords as structured results. This node does not download files or create resources.
workflow.recipe.postParser.name: Parse posts only
workflow.recipe.postParser.description: Read posts and extract download information for preview, copying, export or adding to resource acquisition. Does not start downloads automatically.
workflow.postParser.title: Title (optional)
workflow.postParser.purchaseLimit: Use the configured purchase limit for SoulPlus tasks from the post-parser page
workflow.postParser.noPurchase: Do not purchase paid content automatically
workflow.runs.resultPreviewTruncated: Only part of the output is included in this preview. View the relevant feature page for complete results.
workflow.recipe.parsePostDownloadInfo.de: Read a post or text and extract download links and passwords for preview, copying, export or acquisition. Does not start downloads automatically.
workflow.templates.title: New from template
workflow.templates.description: Choose a workflow for your use case, review its configuration, and save your own version. Templates do not run automatically; built-in workflows are copied.
workflow.sections.label: Workflow sections
workflow.sections.customHint: Workflows you created appear here. Start from a blank workflow or a template, then use the appropriate entry point after saving.
workflow.sections.builtinHint: These workflows serve Get resources, Downloader and Post parser. Enabled means available for use; required configuration and input still apply. Expand the usage guide for the entry point and outcome.
workflow.usage.title: Usage and required configuration
workflow.entry.acquisition.label: Open Get resources
workflow.entry.acquisition.description: Start from Get resources after choosing a pending resource and source. The feature supplies the resource and task context.
workflow.entry.downloader.label: Open Downloader
workflow.entry.downloader.description: Select this as download result processing in the downloader settings. It starts when the downloader supplies a result.
workflow.template.externalDownload.name: Import after an external download
workflow.preset.fileCleaning.scenario: Repeated prefixes, whitespace or inconsistent file names need the same reusable cleanup rules.
workflow.preset.fileCleaning.configurati: Choose server-accessible roots in the scan trigger and configure the file-name rules. Save, run and review the preview.
workflow.preset.fileCleaning.outcome: Produces a rename plan to review and apply from the run history. Running the workflow does not immediately rename files.
workflow.preset.fileCleaning.description:
When to use：Repeated prefixes, whitespace or inconsistent file names need the same reusable cleanup rules.
Configuration and entry point：Choose server-accessible roots in the scan trigger and configure the file-name rules. Save, run and review the preview.
Expected outcome：Produces a rename plan to review and apply from the run history. Running the workflow does not immediately rename files.
workflow.preset.externalDownload.scenari: Use your own client for a magnet or cloud drive, then continue library import after the download.
workflow.preset.externalDownload.configu: Configure pending and library directories. Create this workflow, select it in Get resources, and place the complete resource in the task directory when prompted.
workflow.preset.externalDownload.outcome: Waits for your files, then moves them into the library and links the resource. Preserves folders without extracting archives or launching your external client.
workflow.preset.externalDownload.descrip:
When to use：Use your own client for a magnet or cloud drive, then continue library import after the download.
Configuration and entry point：Configure pending and library directories. Create this workflow, select it in Get resources, and place the complete resource in the task directory when prompted.
Expected outcome：Waits for your files, then moves them into the library and links the resource. Preserves folders without extracting archives or launching your external client.
workflow.preset.sharedContent.scenario: A post or text contains download links that you will download through a cloud drive or another external tool.
workflow.preset.sharedContent.configurat: Add the post URL or text in Get resources; configure Post parser AI, pending and library directories. Imported parsed links skip AI extraction.
workflow.preset.sharedContent.outcome: Extracts and selects a link, waits for your complete download, then extracts archives as needed, moves the files and links the resource.
workflow.preset.sharedContent.descriptio:
When to use：A post or text contains download links that you will download through a cloud drive or another external tool.
Configuration and entry point：Add the post URL or text in Get resources; configure Post parser AI, pending and library directories. Imported parsed links skip AI extraction.
Expected outcome：Extracts and selects a link, waits for your complete download, then extracts archives as needed, moves the files and links the resource.
workflow.preset.directDownload.scenario: You have an HTTP(S) URL that directly returns a file and want the server to download and import it.
workflow.preset.directDownload.configura: Add the file URL in Get resources and configure the library directory. Adjust connections in download settings if needed; a webpage or login page is not a direct file URL.
workflow.preset.directDownload.outcome: Downloads on the server, extracts archives as needed, moves files into the library and links the pending resource.
workflow.preset.directDownload.descripti:
When to use：You have an HTTP(S) URL that directly returns a file and want the server to download and import it.
Configuration and entry point：Add the file URL in Get resources and configure the library directory. Adjust connections in download settings if needed; a webpage or login page is not a direct file URL.
Expected outcome：Downloads on the server, extracts archives as needed, moves files into the library and links the pending resource.
workflow.preset.magnet.scenario: You have a magnet link and want Bakabase to download the files and import the resource.
workflow.preset.magnet.configuration: Add a valid magnet in Get resources and configure the library directory. The built-in BT engine needs reachable peers that provide the content.
workflow.preset.magnet.outcome: Downloads complete contents with their folder structure, then moves and links them in the library. Does not extract archives and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.preset.magnet.description:
When to use：You have a magnet link and want Bakabase to download the files and import the resource.
Configuration and entry point：Add a valid magnet in Get resources and configure the library directory. The built-in BT engine needs reachable peers that provide the content.
Expected outcome：Downloads complete contents with their folder structure, then moves and links them in the library. Does not extract archives and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.preset.torrent.scenario: You have a .torrent file or a URL for one and want its actual contents downloaded and imported.
workflow.preset.torrent.configuration: Upload the torrent or add an accessible HTTP(S) torrent URL in Get resources, and configure the library directory. Reachable peers are required.
workflow.preset.torrent.outcome: Downloads the complete torrent contents, preserves folders, and imports and links them. Does not extract archives and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.preset.torrent.description:
When to use：You have a .torrent file or a URL for one and want its actual contents downloaded and imported.
Configuration and entry point：Upload the torrent or add an accessible HTTP(S) torrent URL in Get resources, and configure the library directory. Reachable peers are required.
Expected outcome：Downloads the complete torrent contents, preserves folders, and imports and links them. Does not extract archives and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.preset.exHentai.scenario: A pending resource has an ExHentai gallery identity and should be obtained through the site downloader.
workflow.preset.exHentai.configuration: Configure the ExHentai account, download method and library directory, then use the gallery source in Get resources. The account must have access to the gallery.
workflow.preset.exHentai.outcome: Downloads images, or continues BT download when the site returns a torrent, then imports and links the complete resource.
workflow.preset.exHentai.description:
When to use：A pending resource has an ExHentai gallery identity and should be obtained through the site downloader.
Configuration and entry point：Configure the ExHentai account, download method and library directory, then use the gallery source in Get resources. The account must have access to the gallery.
Expected outcome：Downloads images, or continues BT download when the site returns a torrent, then imports and links the complete resource.
workflow.preset.platform.scenario: A linked platform account owns the resource, and you want its files or an association with an existing installation.
workflow.preset.platform.configuration: Sync platform resources and configure the account/download directory. Steam installation requires a desktop Steam client on the server machine; a server-only host can link an accessible existing installation.
workflow.preset.platform.outcome: Uses the supported platform operation or detects installed files and links that directory in place. It does not relocate platform files into the library.
workflow.preset.platform.description:
When to use：A linked platform account owns the resource, and you want its files or an association with an existing installation.
Configuration and entry point：Sync platform resources and configure the account/download directory. Steam installation requires a desktop Steam client on the server machine; a server-only host can link an accessible existing installation.
Expected outcome：Uses the supported platform operation or detects installed files and links that directory in place. It does not relocate platform files into the library.
workflow.preset.localDirectory.scenario: The files already exist in a server-accessible folder but are not linked to the pending resource.
workflow.preset.localDirectory.configura: Configure the destination library directory first. Start from Get resources, then select the source folder when prompted; it is not fixed in advance.
workflow.preset.localDirectory.outcome: Moves the selected folder contents into the library and links the resource. The original location changes; this is not an in-place scan.
workflow.preset.localDirectory.descripti:
When to use：The files already exist in a server-accessible folder but are not linked to the pending resource.
Configuration and entry point：Configure the destination library directory first. Start from Get resources, then select the source folder when prompted; it is not fixed in advance.
Expected outcome：Moves the selected folder contents into the library and links the resource. The original location changes; this is not an in-place scan.
workflow.preset.torrentContents.scenario: A standalone ExHentai download produced a torrent, and its actual contents should be downloaded next.
workflow.preset.torrentContents.configur: Select this workflow in Downloader → ExHentai settings → Download result processing before creating the task. The downloader supplies the result; no result ID is entered manually.
workflow.preset.torrentContents.outcome: Downloads contents into that download result directory using the built-in BT engine. Does not create or import a resource; extend a copy if library import is needed.
workflow.preset.torrentContents.descript:
When to use：A standalone ExHentai download produced a torrent, and its actual contents should be downloaded next.
Configuration and entry point：Select this workflow in Downloader → ExHentai settings → Download result processing before creating the task. The downloader supplies the result; no result ID is entered manually.
Expected outcome：Downloads contents into that download result directory using the built-in BT engine. Does not create or import a resource; extend a copy if library import is needed.
workflow.preset.postParser.scenario: Extract download addresses and passwords from a post URL or pasted text, then review them before taking further action.
workflow.preset.postParser.configuration: Configure Post parser AI. Add content on the Post parser page or use this workflow’s run form. Login-protected pages need site configuration; pasting the text is also supported.
workflow.preset.postParser.outcome: Outputs title, links, access codes and archive passwords for review, copying or export. The Post parser page can add selected links to Get resources without starting a download.
workflow.preset.postParser.description:
When to use：Extract download addresses and passwords from a post URL or pasted text, then review them before taking further action.
Configuration and entry point：Configure Post parser AI. Add content on the Post parser page or use this workflow’s run form. Login-protected pages need site configuration; pasting the text is also supported.
Expected outcome：Outputs title, links, access codes and archive passwords for review, copying or export. The Post parser page can add selected links to Get resources without starting a download.
workflow.sections.customEmpty: You have not created any workflows yet. Choose a template and configure it to get started.
workflow.validation.acquisition.exHentai: Configure an account cookie in ExHentai settings first. This check verifies configuration presence; access is validated when the account is used.
workflow.validation.acquisition.steamInv: A Steam source requires a valid positive app ID.
workflow.validation.acquisition.steamNot: Sync the Steam library before using this platform source.
workflow.validation.acquisition.steamCli: This server cannot launch a local Steam client. Install the resource first and make its installed directory accessible to the server before linking it.
workflow.integration.title: Workflows for this page
workflow.integration.description: Each trigger has its own entry point and conditions. See what to configure and when a workflow starts below.
